stemMarkdown: A train 120 m long is running at 54 km/h. How many seconds does it take to pass a telegraph pole? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: To pass a pole the train must cover its own length. Speed $= 54 \times \dfrac{5}{18} = 15.0000$ m/s, so time $= \dfrac{120}{15.0000} = 8.0$ seconds.
altSolutionMarkdown: A pole has no length, so the distance is exactly the train's length — nothing else.
